localAdaptations: None to the content: the four files are upstream byte for byte. MIDI_TRACKS.md sits beside TRAPS.md rather than under docs/firmware/, which the repository ignores to keep firmware out of Git. Their relative links name upstream's own tree. sdk/octabam/docs/remixer/FAILURE_MODES.md stays Modwerk's own register (it carries Modwerk entries since 8 October 2026) and points to this copy.
review: Stock-free scan against the original 1.40C MAIN OS (local, nothing written): no hex string of 8 bytes or more in any of the four files occurs in stock; three 4-byte matches in FAILURE_MODES.md are an address, the value 1 and an exception-screen PC.

No objdump listing in any file; the code blocks are one DSP assembler line (TRAPS.md) and tool command lines (HARDWARE_MATRIX.md). MIDI_TRACKS.md describes record layouts and addresses and quotes two single stock instructions by address, as Modwerk's own trap notes do.
limitations: Documentation only: no code, build input or module source changes. Hardware results in these files are upstream's, measured on their units, and are not repeated on a Modwerk base.
